name: Making Excuses
overview: Scripture reveals that making excuses often stems from a desire to avoid responsibility or fear of consequences, as seen when Adam blames Eve for his disobedience and Moses questions his own abilities to carry out God's commands. The Proverbs passages depict the slothful using exaggerated fears as excuses to shirk duty. Ultimately, the Bible calls for honest confession and turning away from sin rather than covering it up, promising mercy to those who forsake their excuses and embrace accountability.
